storyCards.headline: Get Busy: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Sean Paul's "Get Busy" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Get Busy" is a song by Jamaican dancehall singer Sean Paul, from his album Dutty Rock.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 32 weeks on the chart.

Get Busy was released in 2002.
